summary: Iteration 4 wrap-up verification. Backend: 56/56 pytest pass (added /app/backend/tests/test_phase4_verify.py with 10 new tests covering TTS, locations/nearby+categories+geocode, JADE location-aware chat, trips POST for Voice Wizard, broker dashboard, public /track). Frontend: P0 performance fixes verified — rapid switching across all 9 driver sidebar tabs completes cleanly with body content intact and 0 console errors; window blur/focus cycles trigger no excessive refetches; useSafeFetch abort correctly cancels /api/tts/speak when user navigates off page (observed REQFAIL net::ERR_ABORTED on /api/tts/speak during detention nav). JADE Chat send works end-to-end (POST /api/jade/chat 200 + POST /api/tts/speak 200) and renders POI Leaflet map for 'find me a truck stop nearby'. Voice Trip Wizard modal opens with skip/close. Broker pages (Dashboard, Quote, Carriers, Exceptions, Integrations, Settlements) all render. GPS leaflet 3D map renders; ELD save present; Detention auto-toggle present. Zero console errors, zero unhandled rejections across the full driver + broker walkthrough.

p0_rapid_tab_switching.evidence: Visited 9 driver pages (dashboard, gps, logs, detention, jade, maintenance, fuel, trip, documents) with ~350ms between clicks. body innerText length 477 after rapid sequence — no blank screen, no console errors, no unhandled promise rejections.

window_focus_blur_cycles.evidence: 3 blur->focus cycles fired via window.dispatchEvent. No excessive parallel refetches; abort controllers in useSafeFetch correctly cancel in-flight requests on unmount (observed /api/tts/speak ERR_ABORTED when navigating away from JADE banner trigger to Detention).

driver_login.evidence: POST /api/auth/login 200, lands on /driver with hero KPIs (Drive 4.6h, Cycle 22.5h, Fuel 64%) rendered.

broker_login.evidence: Broker @ /broker; Payouts page shows Stripe Connected + Scheduled $2685.50 + Paid 30D $7330.00 + 3 outbound payouts (Reyes, Crossroads, Pacific Bridge).

gps_3d_map.evidence: .leaflet-container present on /driver/gps; no 'Map container is already initialized' errors during rapid mount/unmount cycles.

eld_edit_save.evidence: [data-testid='eld-save'] present; backend test_eld_crud passes (create+patch+delete with invalid status -> 400).

jade_chat_location_aware.evidence: [data-testid='jade-text-input'] + [data-testid='jade-send-btn'] both present. Sent 'Find me a truck stop nearby' from driver/jade -> conversation grew to 382 chars; observed POST /api/jade/chat 200 AND POST /api/tts/speak 200 in network log; .leaflet-container POI overlay renders. Backend test_jade_chat_location_aware also passes (current_location {Phoenix 33.4484,-112.074} returns non-empty reply).

voice_trip_wizard.evidence: [data-testid='open-voice-wizard'] -> [data-testid='voice-wizard'] modal opens, [data-testid='voice-wizard-skip'] + [data-testid='voice-wizard-close'] present. Backend test_create_trip_voice_wizard passes (POST /api/trips creates, GET /api/trips returns it).

detention_page.evidence: [data-testid='detention-auto-toggle'] visible; no rapid polling crashes; debounced interval verified working under rapid nav.

broker_pages.evidence: All 6 broker routes (/broker, /broker/quote, /broker/carriers, /broker/exceptions, /broker/integrations, /broker/settlements) render with body_len 412-799.

console_errors.evidence: 0 console errors and 0 unhandled page errors across the full driver+broker walkthrough. The only REQFAIL events were Cloudflare /cdn-cgi/rum beacons (irrelevant) and a single intentional /api/tts/speak ERR_ABORTED (proves useSafeFetch AbortController works).

backend_locations_api.evidence: GET /api/locations/nearby (Phoenix coords) returns >=1 POI with name/lat/lng/category/distance_mi; /api/locations/categories returns truck_stop category; /api/locations/geocode resolves 'Phoenix, AZ'.

backend_tts.evidence: GET /api/tts/health 200; POST /api/tts/speak returns audio/* content-type with >= 5KB body (Nova MP3).

action_items: (Optional minor) iteration_3 noted 'jade-chat-send' and 'jade-chat-input' testids missing — clarification: actual testids in code are 'jade-send-btn' and 'jade-text-input'. Recommend renaming to 'jade-chat-send' / 'jade-chat-input' for consistency with the docs OR updating the iteration_3 note. Functionality is fully working either way.

(Optional minor) data-testid='us-weigh-map' still not forwarded to .leaflet-container DOM node by react-leaflet (carried over from iteration_3). Wrap MapContainer in a <div data-testid='us-weigh-map'> to make it queryable. Not blocking — map and 20 ws-{id} markers render correctly.
(Optional) phase3.py has two unused inner classes — dead-code cleanup (carried over).
critical_code_review_comments: useSafeFetch.js — clean implementation: AbortController per call, alive ref prevents setState-after-unmount, swallows ERR_CANCELED. Production-ready.
VoiceTripWizard.jsx posts to /api/trips via backend POST and creates trip name `${origin} -> ${destination} · voice` — verified end-to-end via test_create_trip_voice_wizard.
phase3.py /locations/nearby uses haversine + radius/limit clamp — correct and fast.
Login.jsx Input components rely on `data-testid='login-email/password'` (no `type='email'`), so playwright selectors must use data-testid not input[type='email']. Tests updated accordingly.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all P0 verification flows pass, 0 console errors)

seed_data_creation: test_create_trip_voice_wizard creates a TEST_Voice trip via POST /api/trips and cleans up via DELETE after verifying GET list inclusion.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is wrap-ready. All P0 performance fixes (useSafeFetch, debounced polling, React.memo Leaflet) verified working. JADE chat + Nova TTS + POI overlays + Voice Wizard all end-to-end green. No regressions on broker side. Only carry-over minors are testid naming consistency (jade-text-input vs jade-chat-input) and react-leaflet not forwarding data-testid on us-weigh-map — both cosmetic. Backend 56/56 pytest pass.
